HapHuyet.name: Hấp Huyết
HapHuyet.target_requirements: Living blood-bearing, successfully hit by melee sword attack, positive actual post-defense HP damage
HapHuyet.weapon_independence: Huyết Nha +3 retains independent +7 BLOOD on eligible ordinary landed strikes, NOT sword-skill strikes; Hấp Huyết does not directly restore BLOOD

NgamBanOnDinh.name: Ngắm Bắn Ổn Định
NgamBanOnDinh.effect: After movement <=3m, complete stop, and valid aimed bow/crossbow shot, reduce by up to 15 percentage points ONLY actual hit penalty caused by preceding movement, not below zero; this replaces Lv1 10pp, does not add.
NgamBanOnDinh.requires: Full stop/stable stance and normal aimed shot; standard action and reload constraints remain
does_not_apply: other penalties such as cover, range or wind
NgamBanOnDinh.not_bonus: Not a flat accuracy bonus, auto hit, extra attack or extra action
NgamBanOnDinh.verified_training: T164 foundation 2/3; T165 first failed 2/5 bow and 3/5 crossbow then corrected and passed 4/5 EACH at ~12m after short repositioning
NgamBanOnDinh.verification: Maela T169 separate 8/10 legal hits with bow and 8/10 with Liên Nỏ after unpredictable <=3m steps, full stops and valid reload, following coached technical practice; not guaranteed.
NgamBanOnDinh.nonstacking: Lv2 replaces Lv1 not additive; does not double-apply same penalty with Phối Hợp Kiếm–Nỏ (which addresses distinct switch-only penalty).

PhoiHopKiemNo.name: Phối Hợp Kiếm–Nỏ
PhoiHopKiemNo.valid_transition: Legally completed sword sheathing -> Liên Nỏ Hắc Nha switching and properly loaded/ready for normally timed aimed shot
PhoiHopKiemNo.effect: After legally securing sword and changing to ready/loaded Liên Nỏ, reduce by at most 10 percentage points only actual hit penalty due to this weapon switch on immediate legally timed aimed shot, floor remaining switch penalty at zero. Lv2 REPLACES Lv1 5pp, not additive.
does_not_apply: Free attack or shot out of turn
Damage bonus or reload speed bonus
PhoiHopKiemNo.stacking_guard: Separately Ngắm Bắn Ổn Định Lv2 addresses only actual movement-specific hit penalty up to15pp after <=3m move, full stop and valid aimed shot. Never apply both to a single penalty.
PhoiHopKiemNo.verified_training: T170 Maela's six multibeat loaded/unloaded crossbow sequences: 1 pass loaded, 2 fail premature trigger on unloaded (no shot), 3 pass loaded, 4 pass properly reloaded, 5 pass loaded, 6 pass properly reloaded; 5/6 meets >=5/6 threshold.

HuyetTramNhiLien.name: Huyết Trảm Nhị Liên
HuyetTramNhiLien.resolution: Exactly two sequential melee-sword skill hits, independently evaluated for hit, defense and HP damage; no third hit/guaranteed hit/free action
HuyetTramNhiLien.lv1_superseded: Lv1 1.20 first+0.90 second physical coefficients replaced, not added
HuyetTramNhiLien.earned_via: Edran Nhị Liên Tiết Huyết three-stage qualifying trial, T174 4/5 shadow chains, 3/3 blood-flow-control drills, 3/3 rotating dummy true-cast criteria
HuyetTramNhiLien.weapon_interactions: Huyết Nha +3 +7 BLOOD applies to valid landed ordinary sword hits only, NOT this sword skill; Hấp Huyết HP on valid living blood-bearing damaging melee sword hit, not dummies

GatKiemCanChien.name: Gạt Kiếm Cận Chiến
GatKiemCanChien.eligible: Wielded and ready sword, incoming perceivable physical melee attack within deflectable contact distance; angle, timing, space and reaction availability must permit attempt
GatKiemCanChien.resolution: Must resolve incoming perceivable physical melee strike with feasible position, angle, sword contact and existing combat reaction economy; adjudicate success/partial deflection/failure vs opponent and force. Spend 7STA for legal attempted reaction even if it fails.
GatKiemCanChien.action_economy: Subject to existing combat turn and reaction limits. Does not generate free attacks/ripostes/extra actions or allow arbitrarily many reactions just because STA remains.
GatKiemCanChien.unverified_upgrade: Huyết Nhận Hộ Thế hypothetical BLOOD-enhanced blade defense: NOT learned, NOT active and costs unspecified

refined_recovery.name: Hồi Thế Tinh Luyện
refined_recovery.effect: Greater controlled post-deflection guard position and reduced excessive blade movement, improving feasibility of later legal defense only if positioning, available reaction, time, and attacker force allow it.
refined_recovery.limits: No guaranteed second parry, no extra reaction/action/attack, no auto parry heavy or blind-side attacks, no stun/riposte or invulnerability.
